(4) The scene shifts to the woman dressed in a pink and white maid costume with cat ears, standing in a brightly lit tiled room. (5) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the woman in the maid outfit singing, dancing, and holding a pink applicator. (6) The woman returns to her original tan top, sitting on a couch and holding a 'My Beauty Diary' mask packet. (11) The final scene returns to the tiled room where she laughs after interacting with the boy.
